scientific_question: Examine the blunt-fin flow field and determine which high-speed flow region is strongest. At each location, define speed as the magnitude of the velocity vector. From all non-zero speed values, compute q90, the 90th-percentile cutoff, and retain locations whose speed is greater than or equal to q90. Partition the retained locations into regions using face connectivity. For each region, record its peak speed; select the region with the largest peak, and report that peak speed together with the mean spatial position of the region’s retained locations.
